note: Short, honest in-app help entries keyed by surface. Every entry carries a maturity value and points to fuller documentation. No fabricated capabilities.

maturityLegend.LOCAL_FIRST: Runs on the device; data stored locally.
maturityLegend.PREVIEW: Seeded/in-memory; evolving; not for production reliance.

entries.title: Today / Work Hub
entries.summary: Your personal day and fast entry point. Open Work Hub for the day view; press Command-K for quick navigation to any surface.
tips: Command-K opens the command palette from anywhere.
The three Today landings are Mission Control, Today's Intent, and Work Hub.

entries.title: Business (ERP)
entries.summary: 104 modules across 13 families. Create, edit, and reopen records — they persist locally on this device.
tips: Records are real local data, not a demo.
Some families are permission-gated (e.g. HR read/manage is Manager/Admin only).

entries.title: AI Workforce
entries.summary: Governed AI actions follow intent, governance, permission, execution, evidence. With an AI provider configured, actions run live; without one, you see an honest deterministic fallback.
tips: Configure an AI provider (Anthropic key or local Ollama) in Settings to enable live AI.
Every governed action leaves an evidence trail.

entries.title: Knowledge & AI Memory
entries.summary: Search your work in natural language. Local lexical search always works; enabling semantic ranking (a vector store + embeddings) improves results.
tips: If semantic search is unavailable, results fall back to lexical rather than failing.
Save items to AI Memory, then retrieve them here.

entries.title: Operations
entries.summary: Health, risk, and incident views. The status indicator shows Live only when data actually loaded — degraded and empty states are shown honestly.
tips: A non-Live status is truthful, not a bug — it means data hasn't loaded.

entries.title: Digital Twin Center
entries.summary: A modeled view over your data. This is a Preview surface running on seeded/in-memory data.
tips: Look for the in-app Preview banner — treat this surface as exploratory.

entries.title: Industry Center
entries.summary: 20 vertical solution packs that reuse the enterprise core. Preview maturity (catalog 0.0.0-preview.1).
tips: Select the one pack for your vertical rather than opening all of them.

entries.title: AI Store
entries.summary: Discover, install, and launch AI apps. The catalog is served by the backend.
tips: The AI Store needs the backend; the rest of the app keeps working on local data if it's unavailable.

entries.title: Connectors
entries.summary: 22 integrations (13 production-ready, 9 Preview) via official APIs/OAuth. A connector is listed but not connectable until you supply its OAuth app credentials.
tips: A 'not configured' state is honest — it means OAuth credentials haven't been supplied.
NeuroPause never fabricates a connected state.

entries.title: Administration & Settings
entries.summary: Manage your organization, roles, and 14 settings domains. Tenant isolation is DB-enforced; roles gate sensitive actions.
tips: Set a strong JWT access secret and configure providers before onboarding real users.
Review HR privacy gating and RBAC scopes.
